title: Readable Needle shot traces and centred Lancer optics
context: The owner could not follow long-distance Needle shots to correct aim, and reported the Lancer starting high then flattening. Lancer also needed a reticle related to Quiver without lock behavior.
outcome: Needle now samples its actual fixed-step flight into a bounded visual trace with a bright pixel-sized head and 1.5-second afterimage, adjustable from zero to three seconds. Visibility toggle, expiry and reset own its lifetime. Lancer scope height is independent of animated muzzle height, ballistic recoil/hold offsets are removed from that optic, and fixed circular brackets replace the mil ruler without lock indicators. A steady central emission glow keeps the head-on ribbon visible. Projectile speed, weapon reach and shared damage remain unchanged.
alternatives: Do not slow Needle to make its tracer visible; retain the real trajectory briefly instead.
Exact head-on ribbons collapse visually; the scope adds a small emission glow beyond the near plane, rather than offsetting the beam upward.
A reset browser assertion raced the next target acquisition frame; the test now snapshots reset state atomically.
evidence: npm run check and npm run build passed.
npm run test:browser passed full source suite.
Sniper source/release browser checks exercise 70 m trace retention, visibility and expiry, initial/two-second Lancer centring, reticle identity, audio, reset and draft isolation.
